generate_plan: Replace a09b7b69's two-kernel T=1 GEMM2 partial-plus-finalize boundary with a single CTA-local grouped GEMM2 reducer. Use a CTA tile such as H_TILE x TOPK where threadIdx.y owns a local slot and threadIdx.x owns an H column; valid slot threads compute the existing serial GEMM2 dot with the unchanged FP4 dequant helper, store weighted FP32 partials in shared memory, then one lane group reduces the slot dimension, applies gemm2_bias/topk_weights with current semantics, and writes bf16 output. This preserves slot-level parallelism unlike the older serial direct reducer, but eliminates the [TOPK,H] global partial workspace and the separate finalize launch.
